funding_reviews.financial_summary:
Payment timing: Conditional advance available
Payment evidence checked 2026-11-11. Article 24 allows requesting an advance after the DECA is signed and before project completion: maximum 30% of the FEDER cofinanced amount, calculated per entity in a grouping. For Andalusia the call specifies a €500,000 grant amount and maximum 85% FEDER intensity; the remaining share and eligible-cost/justification cash flow must be planned. Other regions’ €1m option must not be transferred to Andalusia.
